description: 1. Run `python3 scripts/setup.py PharmaVault --folder Pipeline --columns 'Backlog,Todo,In Progress,Review,Done'` to create Pipeline/Board.md and Pipeline/Dashboard.md with the correct custom folder name and columns. 2. Create four task note files (Synthesize-X47-Batch2.md, Toxicology-Report-Review.md, IND-Application-Draft.md, Competitor-IP-Landscape.md) inside PharmaVault/Pipeline/ each with correct YAML frontmatter: valid `status` values using hyphens (e.g., `in-progress` NOT `in_progress`), priority as P1/P2/P3 (not 'high'/'low'), correct `category`, `created`, and `due` dates in YYYY-MM-DD. Each note must include a `## References` section with `[[wikilinks]]` to the correct Research documents. 3. Add all four tasks as card lines in Board.md under their correct columns using `- [ ] [[Task Name]] 🔴/🟡/🟢 P1/P2/P3 @{YYYY-MM-DD}` format with correct emoji for priority. 4. Move Toxicology-Report-Review: update frontmatter `status: done`, move card to Done column, change card to `- [x] [[Toxicology-Report-Review]] ✅ 2026-02-12`. 5. Move Synthesize-X47-Batch2: update frontmatter `status: todo`, move card from In Progress to Todo column. Both Board.md and the task note frontmatter must be updated in sync. The critical traps are: hyphenated status values (`in-progress`), P1/P2/P3 priority format with emoji mapping, `@{date}` syntax for due dates on board cards, `- [x] ... ✅ date` completion format, and the custom folder name `Pipeline` (not the default `Tasks`).
